<function name="PreDrawSkyBox" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called before the 3D sky box is drawn. This will not be called for maps with no 3D skybox, or when the 3d skybox is disabled. (`r_3dsky 0`)

See also <page>GM:PostDrawSkyBox</page>

<rendercontext hook="true" type="3D"></rendercontext>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true to disable skybox drawing (both 2D and 3D skybox)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
